name: Surges

sources.title: Homepage — '100% Honest Marketing Tool Reviews', 180+ tools; leaderboard, deals, Meet the Makers interviews
About — solo-run by marketer Stuart Goulden; reader-funded via affiliate links; 'shout if you spot a tool worthy of a bigger audience'

requirements: Narrow fit: marketing SaaS/tools only — the site's entire premise is matching marketers with marketing tools
No submission form or 'submit a tool' page; coverage is editorial and hand-picked by a single reviewer
Reviews are claimed impartial and firsthand; affiliate income is disclosed but 'never influences scores'
preparation: Confirm the product is a marketing tool (SEO, email, automation, conversion, content)
One-paragraph pitch: what it does, price, why it deserves review
A free trial or review account — the reviewer tests tools firsthand
Optional: offer a reader deal/discount code — the site runs a deals section (e.g. '20% off first 3 months')
workflow: There is no submission route — pitch Stuart Goulden via Twitter/X @stugoulden (the about page links his handle for suggestions)
Alternatively engage via the site's newsletter/contact surfaces
If accepted, coverage appears as a scored review under /ourreviews/<tool>/ and possibly a 'Meet the Makers' founder interview
watchFor: Editorial filter is the value proposition ('antidote to fake reviews') — do not offer payment for a review; affiliate/deal arrangements are the disclosed monetization
Site is a one-person operation — slow turnaround is likely
A review is honest-scored, not guaranteed positive; negative write-ups are possible
Recent content includes non-marketing health topics (biomarker testing, telehealth) — editorial scope is drifting
countsAsLive: A review page under /ourreviews/<product>/ exists on surges.co, or the tool appears on the leaderboard
unknowns: Whether tool suggestions from vendors are accepted at all (no formal intake)
Whether a review requires an affiliate program or reader deal
Current activity level — footer shows © 2025 and the newsletter claims only ~370 subscribers
